summary: docsic 0.5.1: a prepack script builds dist/ on every npm pack and publish, and `docsic sweep` refuses unknown arguments (exit 2) while --help/-h print help before any command runs.
why: npm 0.4.0 and 0.5.0 shipped the stale 0.3.2 build with no sweep or carry, and `docsic sweep --help` had run a real sweep against the brain hub.
